Row.Text: A toolkit of multiplayer quality-of-life features for Civilization VII: a fully synchronized pause (any player pauses, everyone readies or the host resumes for all, with a countdown and an automatic pause when a player disconnects), a Competitive turn timer that scales with each empire, competitive Multiplayer Balance changes, new multiplayer maps with East vs West player placement and a custom resource system, a Multiplayer Rule Set for Free for All and team matches, Civilization VI-style keybinds, and lobby fixes.
